import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
addr = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140abfb30")
f = currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    f = currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionContaining(addr)
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(currentProgram)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 180, monitor)
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        print(json.dumps({"error": str(res.getErrorMessage())}))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({"func": str(f.getName()), "entry": str(f.getEntryPoint()),
                          "size": int(f.getBody().getNumAddresses()),
                          "decomp": res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()}))
finally:
    d.dispose()
